description: This file defines a PHP class 'TimesheetPeriodSubscriber' that extends an event subscriber for handling request events in the OrangeHRM system. It manages timesheet period validation by intercepting specific request paths and throwing exceptions or forwarding requests based on configuration status.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens to kernel request events and enforces timesheet period constraints based on system configuration.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping KernelEvents::REQUEST to the onRequestEvent method with a priority of 100, subscribing this method to handle request events.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles request events; determines if the request URL relates to the time or API/time paths, checks configuration status, and throws exceptions or forwards requests accordingly to enforce timesheet period validation.
